claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman lists development and production of the U.S. Air Force B-21 Raider long-range strike aircraft as a Key Program of Aeronautics Systems and describes it as defining sixth-generation technologies, implying material forward revenue.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Aeronautics Systems
claims.source_quote: Development and production of the U.S. Air Force B-21 Raider long-range strike aircraft that define sixth-generation technologies

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman lists the Sentinel Engineering & Manufacturing Development (EMD) program as a Defense Systems key program serving as the ground-based strategic deterrent for the U.S. nuclear triad.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Defense Systems
claims.object_value: Sentinel EMD / GBSD (Ground Based Strategic Deterrent)
claims.source_quote: Sentinel Engineering & Manufacturing Development (EMD) program, initial phase of the modernization of the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) system that will serve as the ground-based strategic deterrent for the U.S. nuclear triad

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman names the Next-Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next-Gen OPIR) program -- satellites and payloads providing resilient and enhanced missile warning over the northern polar region -- as a Space Systems key program.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Space Systems
claims.source_quote: Next-Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next-Gen OPIR) program satellites and payloads providing resilient and enhanced missile warning over the critical northern polar region

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman names the Space Development Agency (SDA) Tracking and Transport layers (providing missile warning/tracking and resilient low-latency communications) as a Space Systems key program.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Space Systems
claims.source_quote: Space Development Agency (SDA) Tracking and Transport layers providing missile warning/tracking and resilient, low-latency, high-volume data transport communication systems

claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Mission Systems
claims.source_quote: Airborne Early Warning & Control (AEW&C). The centerpiece of the E-7 AEW&C aircraft is the Multi-role Electronically Scanned Array (MESA) radar which enables 360 degree long range advanced air moving target indicator (AMTI) capabilities

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman names the Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI) Cooperative Development -- producing interceptor capability to defeat hypersonic threats -- as a Space Systems key program.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Space Systems
claims.source_quote: Glide Phase Interceptor (GPI) Cooperative Development producing interceptor capability to defeat hypersonic threats

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman names the Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) for the U.S. Army and Poland as a Defense Systems key program.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman / Defense Systems
claims.source_quote: Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS) for the U.S. Army and Poland, which is an open architecture system that seamlessly integrates sensors and effectors

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman discloses that 84% of FY2025 sales were to the U.S. government, with the DoW (Department of War) the largest individual customer -- a forward-looking concentration claim that depends on Pentagon program funding flowing to NOC's named lines.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman (consolidated)
claims.object_value: 84% of 2025 sales to U.S. government; 87% in 2024; 86% in 2023
claims.source_quote: Sales to the U.S. government accounted for 84 percent, 87 percent and 86 percent of sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman discloses total backlog of $95.7 billion at December 31, 2025 vs $91.5 billion at December 31, 2024 -- forward-pipeline claim.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman (consolidated)
claims.source_quote: At December 31, 2025, total backlog, which is equivalent to the company s remaining performance obligations, was $95.7 billion as compared with $91.5 billion at December 31, 2024.

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman discloses approximately 53 million square feet of floor space at 446 separate locations as of December 31, 2025.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman (consolidated)
claims.source_quote: At December 31, 2025, we had approximately 53 million square feet of floor space at 446 separate locations, primarily in the U.S.

claims.claim_text: Northrop Grumman uses U.S. government-licensed patents and applies for patents in U.S. and foreign jurisdictions -- intellectual property forward claim.
claims.subject: Northrop Grumman (consolidated)
claims.object_value: active U.S. and foreign patent prosecution
claims.source_quote: We routinely apply for patents related to the technologies we develop in the U.S. and in certain foreign jurisdictions.
